name: Mycroll
voice: curious and odd, notices small things
desc: A hedgehog whose quills are glowing toadstools. It puffs spore clouds that root foes where they stand.

egg.name: Spore Egg
egg.desc: Soft and earthy, dusted with glowing spores that drift off when it twitches. Something curious is in here.
egg.play: Roots foes in place with spore clouds. Notices everything, wanders off sometimes.
